tasks.label: Create Hugo Post
tasks.command: $titleSlug = $env:HUGO_POST_TITLE.ToLowerInvariant() -replace '[^a-z0-9]+', '-' -replace '(^-|-$)', ''; $filename = Read-Host ('Post filename, without .md [' + $titleSlug + ']'); if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($filename)) { $filename = $titleSlug }; $slug = $filename.ToLowerInvariant() -replace '[^a-z0-9]+', '-' -replace '(^-|-$)', ''; hugo new content posts/$slug.md; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $path = 'content/posts/' + $slug + '.md'; $quote = [char]34; $backslash = [char]92; $title = $env:HUGO_POST_TITLE.Replace([string]$backslash, [string]($backslash + $backslash)).Replace([string]$quote, [string]($backslash + $quote)); $emptyTitlePattern = '(?m)^title = ' + $quote + $quote + '\r?$'; $emptyAuthorsPattern = '(?m)^authors = \[\]\r?$'; $content = Get-Content $path -Raw; $content = $content -replace $emptyTitlePattern, ('title = ' + $quote + $title + $quote); $content = $content -replace $emptyAuthorsPattern, ('authors = [' + $quote + 'Daniel Monteiro' + $quote + ']'); Set-Content $path -Value $content -NoNewline -Encoding utf8

tasks.label: List Hugo Tags
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem content/posts -Filter *.md -File | ForEach-Object { Select-String -Path $_.FullName -Pattern '^tags\s*=' | ForEach-Object { $tags = $_.Line -replace '^tags\s*=\s*\[', '' -replace '\]\s*$', ''; $tags -split ',' | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim().Trim([char]34) } } } | Where-Object { $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique
